verdict.rationale: Factory Missions let users work with Droid to define features, milestones, and success criteria before coding, which is a documented intent-to-spec capability that produces structured, scoped work. Nothing documents ingesting user feedback submissions and converting them into tasks; the Jira and Linear delegation docs cover implementing existing issues, not creating scoped tasks from feedback. missing for 10: documented intake of user feedback submissions, automatic conversion of feedback into structured tasks or tickets, proposed-scope output tied to feedback, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can convert user feedback submissions into structured tasks with proposed scope

citations.quote: Work with Droid to define features, milestones, and success criteria before any code is written.
Use Factory Missions to plan and execute large, multi-feature projects with structured orchestration.
